decisions.statement: The name of the file a page carries beside it is composed here and nowhere else.
A line holds one key a page states, under that key, with the value it states.
The lines are sorted as text, so one property turning moves one line.
A page stating nothing composes no line rather than a blank one.
No file is read here and none is written.

definition: the file beside a page holding what that page states, one line to a property
